def greens(g): return len([1 for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='N'])

    if gr>0 or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("TRIGGERED at pcenter",pc); break
</parameter>
</function>
